entry.name: Deep Learning Specialization
entry.note: Five courses from dense networks through sequence models; the standard second step

reading.format: Five courses delivered online, with hands-on building and training of neural networks.
reading.summary: The Deep Learning Specialization is a five-course program created and taught by Andrew Ng. It teaches how neural networks work from the ground up, including building and training them. Completing it shows understanding of deep learning foundations, practical model techniques, and how to run a machine learning project.
reading.audience: It is aimed at software engineers entering AI, data scientists seeking deeper understanding, and early-career or aspiring machine learning engineers. Prior machine learning experience is helpful but not required.
reading.prerequisites: Comfort with Python and basic linear algebra; prior machine learning experience helpful but not required.
